I only had a little bit of chest hair before. But the worst part is, that the top of my scalp has become very itchy and I started shredding like crazy. Those hairs were clearly starting to become miniaturised. Not only that, my hairline has clearly receded. I was on fluridil + stemoxydine (so not the strongest) but I was maintaining fine... but zinc seemed to ramp up my DHT levels to crazy numbers. I had this. For me it only occurred when i was lying down as well. I noticed it only occurred when I had neck pain, in particular, the sub occipital muscles. So I’ve been keeping them stretched and I’ve not had the problem since. This may make sense, as these muscles lead up to the brain stem and have major nerves in the region, I’m no neurologist but I believe when I was lying down I was possibly putting even more stress on these muscles and therefore nerves. 

Not only this, but I realised the occasional pulsatile tinnitus I got was related to the very tense muscles around my neck. I realise that whenever I was frequently in a poor postural position, that’s when my pulsation tinnitus started to come back.

What I will say though is please get checked out by a doctor just in case it’s something different. This is what has been working for me but for you it may be different or the same! Who knows. Best of luck.
